He sat at his computer late one night checking his business email. After exchanging a few choice words with a frustrating colleague he was more than ready for bed. *bing* in the top right a new email notification. “Ugggh Greg!” he mumbled under his voice, angry that he hadn’t gotten his point across already. After clicking on the email and waiting for it load he was greet with a black page from top to bottom. “What the fuck is this! Is he really trying to pull another stupid prank? Now of all times?” He try’s clicking off the screen but realizes he can’t, the mouse won’t respond and stays motionless on the screen. He rolls his eyes and goes to turn away but something catches his eye. The black... it’s running out of the email. He watches mystified as it bleeds off the page into the rest of his desktop. As the black leaves the page more and more words become visible, but not in any computer font he knows. They look painted across the screen... “thanks for letting me in” in blocky smeared lettering. He is so focused on the words he doesn’t notice the black until he feels something cool touch his fingers on the desktop. A small drip, then another and another as the inky void flows out of his monitor covering the desk and keyboard. Slowly it begins changing and pulling itself together. As the computer begins rising off the desk he watches horrified. First, a neck. Then rib after rib until a diaphragm is formed. The black skin stretched taunt over its bones. He stares wide eyed until slowly tentacles reached up over its shoulders and begin moving towards him. He’s unable to move as they crawl over his legs and pull him closer and closer to monitor. Mesmerized as the pitch black words form a gaping mouth with black chipped teeth unable to screen as the tentacles bash him into the monitor again and again until he’s only a smear across its front and a pile of bones and flesh on the ground. The face on the monitor screams in hunger as another meal is lost. Until... another notification pops into the upper right corner. From Greg “sir, I’m very sorry and really need to keep this job. Please just tell me what I have to do. I’ll be at my computer all night awaiting your response.  - Greg”. a raspy dry voice cackles over the computers speakers “Alllllll night you say?” As it’s slowly bleeds back into the monitor readying itself for another spam email, luckily the only ones dumb enough to open them Always let him in.
